description: In every PA-model, the actual formula test checks that formula depth is nonzero and at most one plus the available slot depth.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.isForm_value.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA] (n e : M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.isForm.value ![n, e] =
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.truthValue
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.formDepth e ≠
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M ∧
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.leValue M
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.formDepth e)
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M n))
